raw_segments.text: Then I suppose that in the city which we are founding you would make a law to the effect that a friend should use no other
familiarity to his love than a father would use to his son and then only for a noble purpose and
He must first have the others consent and this rule is to limit him in all his intercourse
And he is never to be seen going further or if he exceeds he is to be deemed guilty of coarseness and bad taste
